notes:
Quick account snapshot:
- Product: mid-market SaaS (customer success platform) building outbound chat assistant for SDRs; primary need = low-latency streaming + tool-calling into CRM/calendar/email.
- Stakeholders: Head of Product (Priya Rao), VP Sales (Jonas Meyer), Eng Lead (Diego Alvarez). AE: Maya Chen, SE: Liam O'Connor.
- Quote from demo: "We need streaming to feel instantaneous to reps — sub-300ms first-byte ideally, per-token streaming <60ms at 95th for short bursts."
- Current stack: internal CRM (Postgres + GraphQL), Google Workspace calendar + Gmail, Zapier for legacy integrations. Want direct tool calls (OAuth2) from agent to CRM/email/calendar for actions (log activity, send follow-up, schedule).
- POC ask: 2-week sandbox using Hosted API with streaming + tool-calling adapter. Measure 95th p50/p95 latency, per-token jitter, and cost per active session.
- Model preference: prefer open model family (Llama/Meta variants) but want Redwood verification and fallback to smaller / quantized variants for cost. Interested in Dedicated if throughput and SLOs look good.
- Security: must pass internal security questionnaire (SOC2 in place, require audit logs + KMS support + SSO/SAML). Data residency: NA only for now.
- Commercial: leaning toward annual commit if pricing + SLA meet expectations. Target ARR band $80k-$200k.
- Concerns called out: 1) how function-calling maps to their org identities (least privilege), 2) cost predictability when agents burst, 3) how canary roll from Hosted to Dedicated without UX regressions.
- Action items from last call: SE to supply streaming perf matrix, sample tool-caller adapter repo, draft dedicated pricing doc. AE to initiate legal/data flow diagram exchange.
- Notes style: shorthand, bullets, some repeated phrases from calls.
